name: build a flower boutique websit
prompt: build a flower boutique website with animated flowers and make it attractive

project.name: Flower Boutique Website
project.summary: An attractive, visually appealing flower boutique website featuring animated flowers and engaging UI design.

tasks.focus: Define the visual aesthetics, color palette, typography, and botanical imagery styling to ensure an attractive boutique feel.
Establish the responsive HTML5/Tailwind CSS structure, component hierarchy, and layout layout for a single-page web application.
Design the interactive flower animations, floral bouquet customization, catalog filtering, and shopping cart workflow.

design.theme: Ethereal Botanical Luxury: Clean, soft, romantic aesthetic with a modern organic touch, featuring soft pastels, lush botanical photography, and delightful CSS-driven animated flower elements.

typography.font_family: 'Playfair Display', serif for headings; 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif for body text

layout: Fixed minimalist header with blurred backdrop-filter, elegant boutique logo, centered navigation links, and an interactive shopping cart icon badge.
Immersive hero section featuring a split layout with romantic typography, clear call-to-action buttons, and floating CSS/Canvas animated floral illustrations.
Featured bouquet grid with multi-column responsive cards, subtle hover zooms, quick-view buttons, and category filter tabs (Romance, Birthday, Sympathy, Everyday).
Interactive Flower Customizer or 'Build Your Bouquet' section allowing users to pick stems with live visual updates.
Comprehensive footer with newsletter signup for flower care tips, social media links, and boutique location info.
responsive_behavior: Desktop: Full multi-column grid layouts (3-4 columns), spacious padding, side-by-side hero presentation with expansive floating animations.
Tablet: 2-column card layouts, adjusted font scaling, collapsible navigation into a sleek slide-out drawer.
Mobile: Single-column vertical stacking, full-width touch-friendly buttons, simplified animations to ensure optimal performance, bottom sticky navigation bar.
visual_style: Cards feature soft rounded corners (border-radius: 16px), subtle warm drop shadows (box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(44, 42, 41, 0.08)), and clean 1px borders in #F0EBE6.
Buttons feature smooth pill shapes or gentle curves, gradient or solid primary background with lift-up hover transitions and soft glow effects.
animations: Floating CSS keyframe animations for decorative background flower petals and leaves swaying gently.
Micro-interactions on product cards including image zoom on hover and slide-up quick action overlays.
Smooth fade-in and slide-up entrance animations for sections as the user scrolls down the page.

dom_structure: li a (Home, Shop, Occasions, About, Contact)

css_architecture.layout_strategy: CSS Grid for product galleries and CSS Flexbox for navigation, card layouts, and header elements. Absolute positioning with keyframe animations for floating floral elements and canvas interactive particle petals.

js_architecture.state_schema: { products: Array, cart: Array, activeCategory: String, isCartOpen: Boolean, customBouquet: Array }
core_functions: initApp(): Initializes event listeners, loads products, renders UI, starts canvas petal animations
renderProducts(category): Filters and populates product cards into #product-grid
updateCart(productId, delta): Manages cart item quantities and triggers storage update
renderCartModal(): Updates cart modal DOM with items and totals
initFlowerCanvas(): Manages interactive or procedural animated flower petals floating across the hero and footer
event_delegation: Product grid click listener for 'Add to Cart' actions
Navigation click listener for smooth scrolling and category filtering
Modal toggle listeners for opening/closing cart and checkout drawers

constraints: Single self-contained index.html file including all CSS and JS
Zero external build steps or complex node module setups; CDN icons/fonts permitted
Accessible semantic markup with ARIA attributes for modals and buttons
Smooth CSS/Canvas animations optimized for 60fps performance

features.name: Animated Flower Hero Banner
features.purpose: Provides an engaging, visually appealing boutique welcome with floating or blooming animated flowers.
features.interaction: User lands on the page and observes floating/blooming floral animations; can hover over hero elements to trigger interactive petal expansions.
features.behavior: Triggers CSS/JS keyframe animations for floating petals and gentle swaying stems; updates DOM with animated SVG or CSS flower elements.
edge_cases: Prefers-reduced-media query respected to disable heavy animations for accessibility.
Window resize adjusts animation bounds gracefully without layout overflow.

features.name: Boutique Product Catalog Showcase
features.purpose: Displays exquisite flower arrangements and bouquets with prices, descriptions, and imagery.
features.interaction: User browses the flower grid, filters by category (e.g., Roses, Tulips, Exotic), and clicks on products to view details.
features.behavior: Filters the visible product cards in the DOM based on selected category tags; updates active filter button styling in state.
edge_cases: Zero products match selected filter: displays a friendly empty state message with a 'Reset Filters' button.

features.name: Interactive Bouquet Customizer
features.purpose: Allows users to build a custom floral arrangement by selecting stem types, colors, and wrapping.
features.interaction: User clicks through step-by-step options (base flower, accent flowers, vase/wrap) and watches a live preview update.
features.behavior: State tracks selected customization options; DOM dynamically updates the preview illustration and recalculates total price in real-time.
edge_cases: User resets customizer: reverts all selections to default state and clears custom preview canvas.

features.name: Shopping Cart and Checkout Drawer
features.purpose: Enables users to review selected bouquets, adjust quantities, and initiate checkout.
features.interaction: User clicks the cart icon in the header to open the slide-over drawer, adjusts item quantities, or clicks 'Checkout'.
features.behavior: State manages cart items array and total price calculation; DOM slides in the drawer overlay and updates item counter badge.
edge_cases: Empty cart: displays an inviting message encouraging the user to explore the boutique catalog.
Quantity adjusted to zero: removes the item from the cart state and DOM immediately.

features.name: Floral Care Guide & Tips Accordion
features.purpose: Offers expert advice on how to keep bouquets fresh and vibrant longer.
features.interaction: User clicks on accordion headers to expand or collapse specific flower care topics (e.g., water changing, sunlight).
features.behavior: Toggles visibility class on accordion content panels in the DOM and updates active ARIA attributes.
edge_cases: Multiple accordions open simultaneously or exclusive mode depending on design; defaults to all collapsed.

features.name: Customer Testimonial Carousel
features.purpose: Builds trust by showcasing lovely reviews from satisfied boutique customers.
features.interaction: User clicks next/previous arrow buttons or auto-scrolls through testimonial cards.
features.behavior: State tracks active testimonial index; DOM translates the carousel track to display the corresponding review card smoothly.
edge_cases: Index boundary checks wrap around seamlessly from last review to first and vice versa.
